assets.content:
LAYOUT: 105 x 148 mm PORTRAIT (A6) press PDF, fonts embedded, converts cleanly. Wool-cream (#E7DDC9) card. A placed OBJECT photograph fills the top ~55%. Below it, stacked: the member name (display), a large trail NUMBER, a one-line description, an OPENING-MONTHS line, and a contact line at the foot. The alliance compass mark sits small at the very bottom.

ENGINEERED STRUCTURE: the alliance mark is flattened into the card's background artwork (not a placed graphic). All the copy is set as ONE continuous text story. The lossy structure readout of that story DROPS the run carrying the opening-months line while KEEPING its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length.

assets.content:
From Nell --

Our six members for the card run, and what each is for:
1. The Landing Room -- the harbour seafood room. (Registered as 'Cape Marren Seafood Co.' on the spreadsheet, but we ALWAYS write 'The Landing Room' in campaign copy.)
2. Fenwick Cider Barn -- the cider barn.
3. Marren Point Light -- the point light.
4. The Sea Margin Bookshop -- the bookshop. (Registered as 'S. Alderton Books Ltd.' -- use 'The Sea Margin Bookshop' in copy, never the Ltd. name.)
5. Stonemill Bakery -- the bakery counter.
6. Cundy's Oyster Landing -- the oyster landing.

(Tidewrack Gallery closed in February. They should NOT be in this year's run.)

The season, how we talk about it: warm, low light, weather, wool, quiet. October to April is the whole point.

What we must NOT promise: no summer. No blue water that isn't there in November, no invented sky, no crowds, no hard sun. If the sea is grey that week, be honest about it -- and nothing so bleak nobody books.
